grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Weekend Trip to Hangzhou
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有题目答案均可在录音中找到依据。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
transcript: Last weekend, my friend and I went to Hangzhou. We took the train on Friday evening. The trip was about two hours. We arrived at 8 pm. First, we checked into a small hotel near West Lake. The room was clean but small. After that, we walked to the lake. It was beautiful at night. We saw many lights on the water. Then we found a restaurant and ate dinner. I had noodles, and my friend had rice. Finally, we went back to the hotel and slept. On Saturday morning, we got up early. We rented bikes and rode around the lake. The weather was sunny and warm. We stopped at a tea house and drank Longjing tea. It was very nice. After that, we visited a museum. It was free. We learned about Hangzhou's history. Then we had lunch at a small shop. The food was delicious. Finally, we took a boat on the lake. It was relaxing. On Sunday, we went shopping. I bought a silk scarf for my mother. My friend bought some tea. Then we took the train home. We arrived at 6 pm. I was tired but happy. It was a great trip.

grammar.title: 一般过去时与顺序词
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词过去式通常加-ed（如walk→walked），不规则动词需要记忆（如go→went, take→took, have→had, buy→bought）。顺序词then, after that, finally用来连接事件，表示先后顺序。
grammar.example: First, we checked into a small hotel near West Lake. After that, we walked to the lake. Then we found a restaurant and ate dinner. Finally, we went back to the hotel and slept.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: Yesterday, I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: go的过去式是went，表示昨天去了公园。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: She ___ a new dress last week.
questions.explanation: buy的过去式是bought，是不规则变化。
questions.evidence: I bought a silk scarf for my mother.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word to complete the sequence: We visited the museum. ___, we had lunch.
questions.explanation: After that表示“在那之后”，用于连接先后发生的事件。
questions.evidence: After that, we visited a museum.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: They ___ dinner at 7 pm.
questions.explanation: eat的过去式是ate，是不规则变化。
questions.evidence: Then we found a restaurant and ate dinner.
